Every field is {value, source_url, confidence 0-1, last_verified_at}; null means unknown, never a guess. A new value never replaced one of higher confidence; disagreements are in "conflicts". Nothing here has been merged into the site yet. See the top of enrich_companies.py for the rules and the confidence scale.
